note: 三星 Galaxy Store 官方原文分成数据（已验证）

platforms.name: Samsung Galaxy Store
platforms.source_extracted_from: 从 https://developer.samsung.com/ 首页导航 <a href="/galaxy-store"> 提取（第2轮抓取发现）
platforms.category: 手机主题/壁纸/键盘皮肤/表盘商店（综合）
platforms.publish_what: apps, games, themes, IAP, subscriptions；主题另有独立主题设计师计划
platforms.revenue_share_quote: "Galaxy Store Preloaded on 1.2B devices in 188 countries, Galaxy Store offers the latest apps, games, customization tools, exclusive benefits, and a developer-friendly revenue share of 80/20."
platforms.revenue_share_footnote_quote: "80/20 revenue share for paid apps, themes, and consumable and non-consumable items; 85:15 revenue share for subscriptions. Revenue share is subject to deduction of customary fees (such as sales tax, bank fees) as provided in the Galaxy Store Terms."
platforms.revenue_share_summary: 开发者拿80%（付费app/主题/IAP消耗与非消耗）；订阅拿85%；需扣税费与银行手续费
platforms.onboarding_quote: "Create your Samsung account, register with Seller Portal, and apply for commercial seller status."
platforms.settlement_cycle: 页面未直接给出结算周期天数（需进 Seller Portal；后续补充）
platforms.withdrawal_threshold: 页面未给出（需查 Seller Portal / Galaxy Store Terms）
platforms.china_individual: 待验证：需注册 Samsung Account + Seller Portal 商业卖家身份，理论支持个人但收款账户/税务表格是关键
platforms.risk: 🟢 官方主站公开数据，信息可靠
platforms.extra: Galaxy Store in China operates separately（中国区独立运营）；Discover Tab 仅美国+韩国；Samsung Rewards 仅德/韩/美

platforms.name: Samsung Galaxy Themes（主题设计师计划）
platforms.source_extracted_from: 从 https://developer.samsung.com/ 首页导航 <a href="/galaxy-themes"> 提取
platforms.publish_what: 主题包、壁纸、图标、AOD（Always On Display），用 Galaxy Themes Studio 制作 APK 售卖
platforms.entry_condition_quote: "To become a themes designer, you must submit an application with at least three mock-up theme designs. Applications are only accepted during certain times of the year, the Themes Submission Open Window."
platforms.recruitment_quote: "Theme designers are recruited every two years. Those who pass 2023 will be granted a two-year theme seller qualification period."
platforms.qualification_quote: "Qualification period: September 1, 2023 - August 31, 2025 (2 years)… we will comprehensively evaluate whether they comply with the mandatory provisions in the pledge to decide whether to re-approve the theme seller's qualification."
platforms.revenue_share: 未在页面直接给出主题专属分成；复用 Galaxy Store 的 80/20（themes 明确列在 80/20 口径内）
platforms.china_individual: 关键风险：需提交作品集筛选 + 每两年重新认证 + 续期需遵守 pledge 条款；大陆个人身份未说明
platforms.risk: 🟡 门槛高（邀请制+作品集+两年有效期），不是"随便注册就能卖"的低门槛市场
platforms.extra: 官方明说 "To give professional designers a chance to participate in Service Biz"——定位是专业设计师，非素人
